svg.text: Concept 5 — Two cats back to back
Two sitting cats lean back to back. From the front you see two profiles; from the side, a cat face. Tails curl to meet.
All dimensions in mm · concept sketch, not final geometry
access: hand from below, through 3 gaps of ~35-40 mm beside the ring
fits Ø148 ≤ Ø160 · no supports needed
